title: Chapter 1280
text:
Ever since she stepped into the Beyond Grade A realm more than half a year ago, Aurora had received the approval of Han Xiao and Hella to leave the base alone and adventure in the universe. According to her, she had finally made it, so she had to have fun outside before going back.

In the first few months, Aurora traveled around alone, looking at the scenery and experiencing the cultures of different civilizations. However, she soon felt that such a journey was too dull. There were no waves, and it was not as exciting as she had imagined it to be.

Therefore, after Han Xiao returned from the Sanctum, Aurora borrowed Fu Ding from him and asked Han Xiao to use the King to teleport him to her side.

The effect of this was very obvious, and her journey suddenly became exciting. According to incomplete statistics, in the past two months, the two of them had been involved in more than ten incidents of various sizes.

Aurora was very satisfied, but Fu Ding did not have anything to live for. He could only be dragged around and continue his life as a tool.

He could not help but regret separating Chen Xing's soul. Otherwise, he would have been able to pass the time spiritually and not be an obedient mascot like he was now.

Their spaceship was a special grade spaceship specially made by Black Star. The hyperdrive engine, energy shield, detection radar, concealment device, smart protection, and other equipment were all top-notch. Not long ago, the spaceship detected an abnormal energy reaction in this area and deduced that a battle was taking place. The special communication device broke through the channel blocking signal and successfully intercepted Kevin's call for help.

At the same time, Aurora's Esper Ability also detected the life signals of multiple Calamity Grade Supers. She immediately knew that there was something fun to be had. She turned around to take a look and immediately saw this scene.

Although I don't know what happened here, after a few months of traveling, Aurora has already developed her own style of doing things … Regardless of why they are killing each other, before I figure out the ins and outs of the matter, no one is allowed to die!

Unlimited healing power, just that domineering!

Seeing that Kevin was seriously injured and on the verge of death, Aurora raised her hand and gave him a big mouthful of milk without hesitation. With the strength of her Beyond Grade A Esper Ability, healing a Calamity Grade Supers was as easy as breathing. Not only did she instantly pull Kevin back from the brink of death, but she also gave him various strengthening statuses, making him even stronger than when he was at his peak.

"… I'm not dead?"

Gavin lowered his head and stared blankly at his unscathed body. Just now, he had already felt the darkness of death assaulting him. He thought that he was definitely going to die, but this sudden mouthful of milk caught him off guard. He was left with only confusion, and for a moment, he couldn't tell whether this was an illusion or not.

At the same time, the expressions of the Calamity Grade Supers changed drastically, and they scattered.

"It's a Beyond Grade A fluctuation! Run!"

Without hesitation, they split up and fled. Enchanted tattoos lit up on their bodies, all of which were engraved with the magic circuits of Short Distance Teleportation. Space rippled slightly, and everyone's Teleportation entered a state of channeling.

"You want to leave after hitting me?!"

Gavin immediately regained his senses and rushed toward the nearest opponents. An even more powerful flame aura condensed on the edge of his saber. The saber slashed out rapidly, leaving afterimages one after another as it flung out sharp saber lights.

Three people's channeling state was interrupted, and they hurriedly dodged.

A small whirlpool teleportation gate had already appeared in front of the others, and it was rapidly expanding. It would only take a few seconds for the teleportation to complete and allow them to escape from this place.

Seeing that the teleportation spell had already taken shape, the few of them were about to heave a sigh of relief when they suddenly felt a special spatial fluctuation spread out from Aurora's spaceship.

Hum!

This fluctuation was like an iron, directly wiping out all the spatial folds on the battlefield, and the teleportation gates that were about to take shape shattered and disappeared.

On the spaceship, Aurora curled her lips.

"Humph, do you think my spaceship is just a decoration?"

Her spaceship contained a lot of advanced technology, including some that Han Xiao had inherited from Jayz's technology treasure trove. The instant spacetime anchoring was just a child's play.

Seeing this, the faces of the few Calamity Grade Supers froze. They looked at each other and saw the determination in each other's eyes.

The next moment, this group of people gave up on escaping and charged toward the spaceship in unison. Their momentum was unstoppable, as though they wanted to fight to the death.

Fu Ding narrowed his eyes. Just as he was about to make a move, Aurora pressed on his shoulder.

"Stay here. Let me do it."

Aurora's eyes sparkled, and energy surged all over her body. She instantly turned into the mature version, and the Mark of the Underworld on the back of her hand lit up.

She waved her hand, and the life energy, death energy, and revival energy appeared at the same time, intertwining with each other. She used her energy to weave bones, muscles, and blood vessels, turning them into temporary shells of ten different species.

Under the special effect of the Power of Rebirth, the temporary bodies quickly materialized. The details and outline were almost no different from a real physical body. The only difference was that these temporary bodies were all emitting a faint fluorescent light, still retaining a certain energy body characteristic.

Then, she flicked her finger, and ten Calamity Grade Hero Spirits flew out from the Mark of the Underworld, merging into different shells. The next moment, these shells released Calamity Grade energy fluctuations.

Hero Spirits Descend, Edo Reincarnation!

This series of actions was very smooth, and it was unknown how many times they had practiced. Only at this moment did these Hero Spirits become complete, possessing the actual combat strength they had when they were alive.

"Go, take them down." Aurora chuckled.

The ten Calamity Grade Hero Spirits nodded and immediately charged out of the spaceship, intercepting their opponents and fighting fiercely. Seeing this, Kevin did not have the time to be shocked and joined the battle as well.

The Hero Spirits did not care about the death of their physical body, so they did not set up any defenses. This kind of aggressive fighting style was just a normal tactic for them, and they were often able to perform above their usual standards, exceeding their combat strength when they were alive.

Even with the Holy Light Particle, Aurora's frontal attack was still relatively weak. She had already completely gotten used to the summoning style, but she usually only summoned Calamity Grade Hero Spirits because summoning Beyond Grade A Hero Spirits consumed too much energy. Furthermore, she had promised Han Xiao that she would not allow Beyond Grade As to come out for a walk so easily.

There was no suspense when a Beyond Grade A bullied a Calamity Grade Super. These Calamity Grade Supers of unknown origins were quickly forced to retreat, covered in wounds.

Seeing that they were about to be captured alive, this group of people gritted their teeth as though they had made up their minds. They crazily compressed the energy in their bodies, and the surface of their bodies was quickly covered with glowing cracks.

"They're going to self-destruct!"

Gavin was shocked and subconsciously retreated.

He did not expect this group of people to be so decisive, willing to self-destruct rather than be captured alive.

Boom!

The next moment, their bodies suddenly self-destructed, and a shockwave burst forth.

However, just as the self-destruction began, a holy light shot out from the spaceship again, sweeping past them. The shattered bodies of this group of people were glued back together, returning to their original state.

Their pupils constricted, and they self-destructed again without hesitation. However, the same thing happened again. Just as they felt the pain of their bodies tearing apart, another holy light shot out, wiping away their injuries again.

After trying several times, the result was the same. The determination on their faces turned into confusion and despair. They already understood that their lives were no longer in their control from this moment onward, and they could not even commit suicide …

They could neither live nor die!

"Alright, stop playing with them. Let me do it."

Fu Ding shook his head helplessly.

He took out the Soul Swapper, extracted their souls, and transferred them into a few prepared animal containers.

After a few decades, Fu Ding had finally entered the ranks of the Beyond Grade A seeds. With the help of the Soul Swapper, it could be said that he was unmatched among the Calamity Grades.

These people's bodies instantly turned into empty shells, and they were easily captured alive and brought into the spaceship. The remaining Hero Spirits began to clean up the battlefield.

Seeing this, Kevin finally relaxed, and his heart was filled with the joy of escaping death. He hurriedly said in the public channel, "I'm Kevin.

You've saved my life. I wonder if I have the honor of thanking you in person? "

After a few seconds, a reply sounded in the channel.

"Let's talk on the spaceship."

Kevin's spirits were lifted, and he approached the spaceship. The hatch opened, allowing him to fly into the cabin.

Following the guidance robot to the command room, Kevin immediately saw the eye-catching Aurora and bowed respectfully without hesitation.

"So, it's the new Deputy Army Commander of the Black Star Corps, 'Goddess of Life' Aurora. It's truly my fortune to meet you!"

When Aurora made her move for the first time, Kevin had already vaguely guessed the identity of her helper, but he only dared to confirm it when he saw her in person.

Kevin's heart was filled with joy.

Luckily, he met Aurora, who had the Esper Ability of Life. If it had been anyone else, they might not have been able to pull him back from the brink of death.

In the vast universe, I just happened to meet a Beyond Grade A who can save me. What kind of probability is this?

My luck is too good!

Aurora originally wanted to learn from Hella and act cold, but she was stunned for a moment. "Hmm? When did I get this nickname?"

"You don't know?" Kevin explained. "Because you're the sister of 'Goddess of Death' Hella and have the opposite ability, the outside world gradually started to call you that."

"Not bad, not bad. I'm someone with a nickname now." Aurora was overjoyed.

Although she only had one nickname at the moment, and Hella had a bunch of titles such as' Goddess of Death ',' Crimson Snake ',' Life Breaker ', and so on, this was a good start. Sooner or later, she would be able to suppress her sister and hold her head high!

Imagining this scene, Aurora could not help but feel excited.

Fu Ding immediately knew that Aurora had spaced out again, so he had no choice but to continue the conversation.

"Ahem, we received your call for help, so we came in time. Tell us the cause and effect, what happened here?"

"It's like this. I was on my way when I suddenly met a group of galactic pirates …"

Gavin recounted the entire process without concealing anything.

After listening to the whole process, Fu Ding stroked his beautiful chin and guessed, "This isn't a simple matter.

These people are definitely not simple galactic pirates. I think they're here specifically for you. Maybe it's a revenge? "

"That doesn't make sense. I've always been kind to others and have never stepped into the conflicts of any faction. Even if I want to kill someone, I'll do it by the roots. I've never provoked an organization that can release seven or eight Calamity Grade assassins at once."

Gavin was at a loss.

Hearing this, Fu Ding pondered and said, "It's not a revenge.

Then, it's very likely to be related to the recent storm. "

"What do you mean?" Kevin was curious.

"Hmm, I'm not sure yet, but we've captured them alive. We'll know after some interrogation …"

Fu Ding shook his head. He suddenly paused and changed the topic.

"You just said that you're going to the Flickering World to join the Black Star Corps?"

"Yes …"

"Great!" Fu Ding's eyes sparkled. "You don't have to go all the way to the Flickering World. It's so dangerous. The Vice Army Commander is right in front of you. Why do you have to go so far? Aurora is completely qualified to recruit new people. Why don't you just stay and become her Black Star Guard?"

"Huh? This … "

Kevin was stunned for a moment and hesitated.

His goal was actually to become Black Star's Black Star Guard. However, Aurora had just saved his life. Although she was a new Beyond Grade A, her Esper Ability was special, and her healing ability was strong enough to ensure the safety of his followers in any situation.

Furthermore, he might encounter danger in the Flickering World, so staying by Aurora's side for the time being was not bad. Kevin was a little tempted.

"Yes, yes, yes. Come under my command. As long as you come, I'll give you the position of captain of the Black Star Guards!" Aurora's eyes sparkled.

She was now the Vice Army Commander and had the qualifications to mobilize the army's manpower to form a team of trusted subordinates and Black Star Guards. However, she had been busy traveling ever since she was promoted and had not recruited a single person.

The talents in the army had already been divided up by Black Star and Hella. Even if she mobilized them internally, she would not be able to find many experts. She had always been envious of Hella's personal guards and did not want to be inferior.

Now that she had encountered a Beyond Grade A seed who was in trouble, Aurora was immediately tempted.

Gavin hesitated for a while, but he was finally tempted and agreed.

"… Alright, I'm willing to become your captain of the Black Star Guards."

He had done some research on the organization structure of the Black Star Corps. From his perspective, there were only three factions in the army, each led by a different Beyond Grade A.

Black Star was undoubtedly in charge of the faction, but there were too many talents in it, and there was no chance for him to show off. Hella's faction was mostly female and had already formed. It did not seem to have any intention of expanding. Furthermore, it was said that Hella was not easy to get along with and was not a suitable leader. Aurora's new faction had just been established, and it was currently lacking people. If he became an early follower of a new Beyond Grade A, his position in the army would definitely be extraordinary.

Although Kevin's original intention was the Sanctum Revival, since he had decided to join an organization, he was not satisfied with being a marginal person with no sense of presence. If he wanted to do something, he would do his best.

"Great, I'll help you register for the army right away! Philip! Come out! "

Aurora was overjoyed and immediately summoned Philip. She couldn't wait to register Gavin as the captain of her Black Star Guards. She was in a hurry, as if she was afraid that someone would cut her off.

Why is she even more excited than me?

Kevin complained in his heart, but he had no choice but to cooperate.

However, he was not disappointed by Aurora's lack of arrogance and eagerness. Instead, he was a little flattered and felt the feeling of being valued by a big shot. Warmth surged in his heart and he was inexplicably touched.

Seeing this, Fu Ding did not disturb them. He simply walked to the side, entered the mental domain, and began interrogating the captives.

After a while, Aurora brought Kevin to complete the procedures, and the Hero Spirits also finished cleaning up the battlefield.

This time, the two of them saw Fu Ding walking back with a solemn expression.

"You're done interrogating? How's the situation? "Aurora was curious.

"… The situation is beyond our expectations. Things are much more serious than we thought."

Fu Ding shook his head and said with a firm tone, "Immediately report this to the Commander.

This is not a problem we're qualified to deal with! "
